name: SIGMA 2S Pro
summary: SIGMA 2S Pro is DZZ Robotics’ desktop bipedal humanoid for robotics education and experimentation. Its exposed articulated structure includes a head, torso, two arms and two legs with flat feet. The manufacturer presents it as an intelligent educational platform for exploring robot mechanics, movement control and artificial intelligence. The cover is the exact native transparent render linked to its product record. Current ordering and shipment availability are unverified.
